refnamediv.refpurpose: Estimate the Equivalent Noise Bandwidth (ENBW) of a window.

listitem.para: Positive scalar (optional). Specifies the sampling rate of the window. Default is 1.
Scalar. Returns the two-sided equivalent noise bandwidth for a uniformly sampled window.

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: This function estimates the Equivalent Noise Bandwidth (ENBW) of a given window. The ENBW is calculated as the ratio of the root mean square (RMS) value of the window to its mean, squared. If the sampling rate `fs` is provided, the bandwidth is scaled accordingly.

refsection.title: Examples
refsection.programlisting: // Without sampling rate: window = 1:10 bw = enbw(window) // With sampling rate: window = 1:10 fs = 2.5 bw = enbw(window, fs)
